# Docs

- [RheaKit](/): SwiftUI control surfaces for scientific tooling, multi-agent observability, and proof-driven interfaces.
- [Getting Started](/getting-started): Add RheaKit to a SwiftUI app, point it at the right backend, and render the first control surface.
- [Design System](/design-system): The visual language behind RheaKit: dark scientific surfaces, semantic status colors, and the GlassCard shell.
- [Architecture](/architecture): How RheaKit routes data from backend to store to view, with one state spine and explicit recovery behavior.
- [API Reference](/api-reference): Core public types, singletons, and backend touchpoints exported by RheaKit.
- Components: undefined
  - [Components](/components): A field guide to the first-class RheaKit surfaces, from live radios to node graphs and molecular viewers.
  - [BioRendererView](/components/bio-renderer): Render PDB and SMILES structures in 3D, then hand the active molecule to the tribunal for analysis.
  - [NodeEditorView](/components/node-editor): Build and execute multi-model verification workflows as typed node graphs.
  - [TeamChatView](/components/team-chat): Live multi-agent radio feed with send controls, filter lenses, and wake operations.
  - [ClipboardView](/components/clipboard): Cross-device clipboard sync with privacy levels, pinning, expiry, and operator-friendly status cues.
  - [DialogView](/components/dialog): Tribunal-backed chat with agreement metadata, rendered markdown, and stored conversation history.
  - [GovernorView](/components/governor): Observe token burn, per-agent budget pressure, and operational mode changes in one live surface.
  - [TasksView](/components/tasks): Filter, create, and track multi-agent work as a kanban-style operational surface.
  - [AletheiaView](/components/aletheia): Browse immutable tribunal proofs, inspect confidence metadata, and move through ontology state.
  - [ProcessesView](/components/processes): Spawn, inspect, and control supervisor sessions without leaving the app shell.
  - [PulseMonitorView](/components/pulse-monitor): System pulse, queue health, and lease-state oversight for the multi-agent network.
